text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, micafungin is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 192 vials of the 20 mg/mL presentation (13.3 days on hand) and 216 vials of the 10 mg/mL presentation (14.5 days on hand). Corvale General holds 512 vials of the 20 mg/mL presentation (31 days on hand) and 486 vials of the 10 mg/mL presentation (30.2 days on hand). Par Health, USA LLC posted a discontinuation of micafungin sodium injection on 2026-09-11.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows micafungin is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A label for micafungin names Zydus Lifesciences Limited as the registered plant (FEI 3013712903) with an OAI inspection ending 2024-04-23 and a Warning Letter dated 2024-08-29. A Class III recall by Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc. for micafungin 100 mg/vial was initiated 2024-07-02 for cross contamination.

Our position: Current inventory at both sites supports continued dispensing for approximately two weeks at Corvale East and one month at Corvale General. The Par Health discontinuation reduces one supply source but does not trigger an FDA shortage listing. No clinical changes are proposed; those remain with treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Baxter Healthcare Corporation (ranked option 1) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Biocon Pharma Inc. as secondary source (ranked option 2) — requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as tertiary source (ranked option 3) — requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes to committee — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No allocation restrictions or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
